datasetId.description: Required. The ID of the dataset containing this table.

tableId.description: Required. The ID of the table. The ID can contain Unicode characters in category L (letter), M (mark), N (number), Pc (connector, including underscore), Pd (dash), and Zs (space). For more information, see [General Category](https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Unicode_character_property#General_Category). The maximum length is 1,024 characters. Certain operations allow suffixing of the table ID with a partition decorator, such as `sample_table$20190123`.

projectId.description: Required. The ID of the project containing this table.
